title: Peter D NDE 21408
content: I was dizzy all day. My teachers asked me if I wanted to go to the clinic and then go home but I suggested that I was ok and that I will be fine. After that, everything got blurry. I remember being at lunch. My friend Jeremy was in line and his brother, Joe, was right behind him. When they got out of line, I was standing and I remember saying, ‘My fourth hour teacher asked me if I wanted to go to the clinic and I said no.' Then after that It went black. I can remember hearing questions and seeing myself on the ground but I was just lying there. Then I remember them putting me in an ambulance but seeing that from another point of view. Then I Was blank for a while and then I remember hearing an unfamiliar voice saying my name. I opened my eyes and found myself in an ambulance with oxygen hooked up to me I asked then what happened and they said I had a seizure.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Sinus Infection that triggered a Seizure. I had a seizure.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes They appeared to be the people helping me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm My vision was blurry.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Conservative/fundamentalist I like the older days better
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist I just want to live
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was the return to normal. When I saw myself I was scared.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They told me it was an out of body experience.
